description: Canonical Boolean algebra axioms. Immutable once frozen. All conditional logic in the system must satisfy these axioms.

axioms.name: Commutativity (AND)
axioms.statement: a AND b = b AND a

axioms.name: Commutativity (OR)
axioms.statement: a OR b = b OR a

axioms.name: Associativity (AND)
axioms.statement: (a AND b) AND c = a AND (b AND c)

axioms.name: Associativity (OR)
axioms.statement: (a OR b) OR c = a OR (b OR c)

axioms.name: Distributivity (AND over OR)
axioms.statement: a AND (b OR c) = (a AND b) OR (a AND c)

axioms.name: Distributivity (OR over AND)
axioms.statement: a OR (b AND c) = (a OR b) AND (a OR c)

axioms.name: De Morgan (AND)
axioms.statement: NOT(a AND b) = NOT(a) OR NOT(b)

axioms.name: De Morgan (OR)
axioms.statement: NOT(a OR b) = NOT(a) AND NOT(b)
